info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Business Risk Models API
info.description: The Business Risk Models API provides access to various banking risk models that help assess business-related financial risks. Users can retrieve detailed insights and analytics about specific business risk models, enabling better decision-making and risk management. This API is essential for financial analysts, risk managers, and banking institutions aiming to enhance their risk assessment processes. It supports a range of typical use cases, including compliance monitoring, loan underwriting, and strategic planning.

get.summary: Retrieve a specific business risk model.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch detailed information about a specific business risk model identified by its unique identifier, enabling users to understand the intricacies and parameters associated with that model.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve detailed information regarding business risk models. Each parameter contributes to filtering and determining the specific business risk model to be fetched.

200.description: The request was successfully processed and the business risk model details are returned.

GetBusinessRiskModelRes100045Request.description: This schema represents the JSON request body for the Operations GET request related to business risk models.

modelId.description: The unique identifier of the risk model.

modelVersion.description: The version of the risk model.

portfolioId.description: The identifier for the portfolio associated with the risk model.

asOfDate.description: The date as of which the model is applicable.

scenario.description: Description of the scenario under which the risk model was assessed.

confidenceLevel.description: The level of confidence in the model's predictions, ranging from 0 to 1.

validationDatasetId.description: The identifier for the dataset used to validate the risk model.

backtestWindowMonths.description: The number of months used for backtesting the model.

approvalStatus.description: The current approval status of the risk model.

recordStatus.description: The status of the record within the model.

version.description: The version number of the response model.

updatedAt.description: The timestamp of when the model was last updated.

responseId.description: The unique identifier of the response.

correlationId.description: The correlation identifier for tracing the response.

generatedAt.description: The timestamp when the response was generated.

processingRegion.description: The region where the response was processed.

metadata.description: Contains additional metadata related to the response.

GetBusinessRiskModelRes100045Response_20.description: Represents the response model containing business risk information for operations.

X-Endpoint-Id.description: A unique identifier for the API endpoint being accessed.

X-Runtime-App.description: The name of the application that is executing the request.

bearerAuth.description: This security scheme uses a Bearer authentication method, which requires a JSON Web Token (JWT) to be included in the Authorization header of requests. The JWT should be obtained through a login process and must be sent for each request that requires authentication.
